title: Research Philosophy
summary: I pursue research that unites rigorous method with practical impact—advancing AI/ML, cloud systems, and security with reproducible results, ethical framing, and clear scholarly communication.

pillars.title: Methodological Rigor, Reproducibility
pillars.description: Design sound experiments, share artifacts, and favor transparent pipelines—so findings can be trusted, extended, and taught.

pillars.title: AI/ML for Real Systems
pillars.description: Build deployable models for networks, cloud, and IoT; measure where it matters: latency, robustness, generalization, and cost.

pillars.title: Security-First Thinking
pillars.description: Treat adversaries as first-class constraints; integrate detection, response, and resilience into system design from the start.

pillars.title: Ethics and Societal Impact
pillars.description: Frame questions around privacy, fairness, and accountability; publish with clear risk analyses and de-biasing strategies.

pillars.title: Scholarly Communication
pillars.description: Write to be read: LaTeX mastery, precise figures, credible citations; distill ideas so others can build on them.

callout: Impact isn’t accidental—it’s engineered through rigor, clarity, and care.
